confidence_method: Conservative evidence rubric: any high or unknown risk => Low; at least two medium risks => Medium; otherwise High. This is an analyst evidence assessment, not a statistical probability.

factors.reason: Quarterly guidance supports near-term growth, but does not establish a ten-year path.
AI is a large and fast-changing portion of consolidated revenue; mix and economics can change quickly.
Hyperscaler spending and semiconductor demand can slow; slowdown scenario reduces growth and margins.
Non-GAAP guidance is not the model margin after SBC. Future systems mix and customer bargaining can compress margins.
Working-capital and capital-intensity paths are analyst assumptions, with limited visibility into future systems delivery.
21% is an explicit normalized estimate; historical tax benefits do not establish a sustainable rate.
Five end customers represent 55% of latest-quarter revenue; distributor exposure overlaps and must not be added.
Customer internal design and alternative accelerator ecosystems threaten both volume and margins.
PV terminal value / enterprise value; above 75% is high, above 50% medium (framework judgment thresholds)
Scenario values are widely dispersed: valuation uncertainty is high.
factors.formula: (maximum scenario value - minimum scenario value) / central value; positive maximum/minimum ratio

range.reason: The slowdown and execution-upside operating paths bound a working range for the explicitly modeled AI outcomes. They are not exhaustive tail outcomes.
range.definition: Scenario-supported working valuation range, not a statistical confidence interval or exhaustive bound.
range.formula: Minimum and maximum of the three explicitly selected operating scenarios

display_values.formula: Round exact scenario-derived USD/share values to nearest $5 for conclusions

sensitivity.formula: Reprice unchanged central operating DCF with one assumption shifted in every forecast year; span = absolute difference between two values

central_assumptions.reason: Analyst estimate: explicit AI adoption path with growth fading, non-AI semiconductors growing modestly and software compounding. Central AI growth is below the aggressive analyst-reported 2027/2028 outlook, reflecting delivery and concentration risk. Downside slows AI and compresses its margin; upside tests execution nearer that outlook. Margins include SBC and all allocated corporate costs, exclude acquisition amortization and include physical depreciation. No style premium or probability weighting. These are rolling TTM forecasts, not exact fiscal-year guidance.

snapshot_context.driver: AI revenue growth translated into after-SBC margins and FCFF.
snapshot_context.risk: Customer concentration and AI execution or margin shortfalls.
snapshot_context.thesis_break: Reassess the central thesis if annual AI revenue growth falls below 20% during the first two forecast years, or consolidated after-SBC operating margin falls below 35%. Analyst monitoring thresholds, not management guidance.
